title: Land through a landing sequence
goal: Plan a landing, fly away, and let Return to launch bring it in through the landing sequence.

steps.text: Plan a landing into the ring with Add a pattern › Landing, then upload the plan.
steps.hint: Click the ring to touch down, then where the approach starts, about 600 m away into the wind.

steps.text: Fly out to the far ring, then press Return to launch.
steps.hint: Use Fly to on the far ring. Return to launch then flies to the landing sequence, not home.

steps.text: Watch it join the landing sequence and land in the ring.
steps.hint: It flies to where the approach starts, then down the approach to the touchdown.

fails.says: Failed. Return to launch had no landing sequence to join, so it went home to circle. Plan a landing first.
Failed. Landed {distance:ring} m from the ring.

passed: Passed. Landed {distance:ring} m from the middle of the ring.
